# hue_smart_scene (Resource)

Manage a Hue smart scene's recurring schedule. Runtime activation is read-only; creating or updating a schedule does not recall it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hue_smart_scene" "natural" {
  name  = "Natural light"
  group = hue_room.study.id

  transition_duration = 60000
  week_timeslots = [{
    recurrence = ["monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday"]
    timeslots = [
      { start_time = "07:00:00", scene = hue_scene.day.id },
      { start_time = "sunset", scene = hue_scene.evening.id },
      { start_time = "00:00:00", scene = hue_scene.dimmed.id },
    ]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Room or zone UUID. Changing the group replaces the smart scene.
- `name` (String) Smart scene name.
- `week_timeslots` (Attributes List) Ordered daily schedules. Each weekday may occur in only one schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--week_timeslots))

### Optional

- `transition_duration` (Number) Transition duration in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Smart scene UUID.
- `image_id` (String) Image UUID preserved from the bridge. Images are not modified by this resource.
- `state` (String) Runtime activation state: active or inactive. Never sent as a configuration update.

<a id="nestedatt--week_timeslots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `week_timeslots`

Required:

- `recurrence` (Set of String) Weekdays in lowercase, such as monday or sunday.
- `timeslots` (Attributes List) Ordered scene transitions for these weekdays. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--week_timeslots--timeslots))

<a id="nestedatt--week_timeslots--timeslots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `week_timeslots.timeslots`

Required:

- `scene` (String) Scene UUID. Use a hue_scene resource reference when managed.
- `start_time` (String) Local time as HH:MM:SS, or sunset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hue_smart_scene.natural 55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555
```
